title: Property Tax Adjustments & Public Land Exemptions
summary:
*   **Tax Assessment Correction:** The city council corrected an error in property tax assessments for Mrs. Ada Maddox and Mrs. Ione Whitlock, lowering their valuation from $8385 to the correct $6400 for 1922 and 1923.
*   **Church Property Tax Relief:** A request from MK&T Land Company for tax remission on certain church property was referred to the City Attorney for legal review.
*   **Public Land Tax Cancellation:** The council formally canceled 1921 tax assessments on a section of property in Block 109, recognizing it as public land owned by Travis County.
